basic_info.description: Welcome to this spacious and bright duplex, ideally located across from the Golden Gate Park in the heart of the Richmond District. This rare opportunity combines timeless charm, generous living space, and incredible potential. Each unit features a similar layout, including an expansive living room with a fireplace and front-facing windows, a formal dining room, two bedrooms, a sunroom perfect for a home office or guest space, and 1.5 bathrooms. One unit is currently occupied by a reliable tenant, the other is vacant—ideal for a future tenant or owner-occupant looking to live in a prime location. Both units have been updated over time and are equipped with in-unit laundry rooms. Each unit is individually metered for electricity and gas. The top-floor unit features fresh paint, an updated kitchen with new SS appliances, refinished hardwood flooring. Downstairs, the 3-car garage provides generous parking and storage space. Bonus Potential: This property offers the opportunity to build a third unit with its own private entrance and backyard access (buyer to verify with city planning). Whether you're an investor seeking rental income or a homeowner looking for a beautiful place to live with income potential, this property offers the best of both in an unbeatable location!
